choices.reason: Neither performance level is designated primary, both appear in the abstract/introduction, and the earlier rules do not separate these distinct outcomes from the same session and arms. Rule 6 favors dyad-level novelty for the full analytic sample over human-level novelty, which excludes four treated participants who shortlisted no own ideas.
